subject.why: The rowboat is immediately recognisable, complete with seats, oars in their oarlocks, and the requested red-and-white pennant at the stern.

category.why: The boat rests naturally in the shallow water and sand forming a clear ground plane across the bottom, suited to category 4.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The rowboat is prominently centered with comfortable margins around all sides.

colour.why: The palette is bright and saturated with warm golden sand, crisp blue water and sky, and bold red accents that pop clearly.

detail.why: The shapes are simple and chunky with no noisy micro-details or clutter.

style.why: The 3D stylized look features soft satin shading, clean bevels, and smooth materials consistent with the game references.
